title: Trump’s Claim That Venezuela ‘Stole’ U.S. Oil Fields Sets Off a Nationalist Reaction
description: President Trump said the United States wanted to reclaim expropriated oil assets, setting off a nationalist reaction in a country where the resource holds a mythical status.

title: Mexico Asks UN to Step In Amid US-Venezuela Standoff
description: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum has called on the United Nations to intervene amid escalating tensions between the United States and Venezuela, accusing the international body of failing to fulfill its obligation to pursue a peaceful resolution.

title: Donald Trump says Venezuela 'took all our oil and we want it back'
description: Donald Trump has claimed Venezuela has stolen 'all' of the oil from the United States.

title: Stephen Miller Echoes Trump on Venezuela, Calls Country's Oil Nationalization 'Largest Recorded Theft of American Wealth'
description: Stephen Miller, president Trump's White House Deputy Chief of Staff, endorsed the president's claims that Venezuela's oil nationalization constituted a massive theft from the United States.

title: American Conservative Commentator Tucker Carlson Makes Huge Claim About Donald Trump's Announcement Tonight
description: War With Venezuela: The United States (US) is awaiting a nationally televised address by President Donald Trump, amid rising speculation that Washington could announce a major escalation in its standoff with Venezuela

title: Sen. Tuberville to Newsmax: Trump Taking on Venezuela's 'Communist Killer'
description: Sen. Tommy Tuberville, R-Ala., warned that Venezuela's socialist regime has become a direct threat to the United States, adding that President Donald Trump is finally taking decisive action after decades of failed policies.

title: Mexico, Brazil call on UN to tamp down U.S.-Venezuela tensions, as China criticizes 'bullying' of its ally
description: The presidents of Latin America's two largest countries urged restraint on Wednesday in the face of escalating actions from the United States toward regional neighbour Venezuela.

title: UN chief Guterres calls for restraint between US, Venezuela
description: United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called for restraint and the immediate de-escalation of tensions between the United States and Venezuela, his spokesperson said on Wednesday.

title: Alexander Lukashenko to Newsmax: US-Venezuela Clash Would Be 'Second Vietnam'
description: Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko warns in a Newsmax interview that the United States could risk a second Vietnam by using military force against Venezuela in its fight against drug trafficking and illegal immigration from the South American nation.
